{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Compute mean flipper length by species using the full dataset (including rows with missing 'sex')
mean_flipper_by_species_full = penguins.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()

# Print the result
print(mean_flipper_by_species_full)

# Identify the species with the highest mean flipper length
best_species_full = mean_flipper_by_species_full.idxmax()
print(f"\nSpecies with highest mean flipper length (full dataset): {best_species_full}")"}
